records.name: l10n_latam.payment.mass.transfer.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form>
                <field name="check_ids" invisible="1"/>
                <field name="journal_id" invisible="1"/>
                <field name="company_id" invisible="1"/>
                <group>
                    <group name="destination_journal_group">
                        <field name="destination_journal_id" options="{'no_open': True, 'no_create': True}" required="1"/>
                    </group>
                    <group name="other_check_info">
                        <field name="payment_date"/>
                        <field name="communication"/>
                    </group>
                </group>
                <footer>
                    <button string="Create Transfers" name="action_create_payments" type="object" class="oe_highlight" data-hotkey="q"/>
                    <button string="Cancel" class="btn btn-secondary" special="cancel" data-hotkey="x"/>
                </footer>
            </form>
        </field>
